stem:
Rohan puts a thin paper sheet between a magnet and a compass needle.

What should happen to the needle?

options.text: The needle stops responding; any sheet blocks the magnet.
The needle can still turn; a thin paper sheet does not cut off the magnet's effect.
The needle responds only if the sheet is removed.
The compass becomes a magnet and ignores the bar magnet.

teacher.key_rationale: A common thin paper sheet does not cut off the magnet's effect on the needle.
